subject.title: chore(deps): refresh Swift toolchain and system pin

question: Should this workflow and dependency refresh merge only after the current-head lint failure is resolved and the full Swift 6.2/6.3.3 matrix runs?
rationale: The maintenance direction is sound, but only the repository owner can decide whether the reported local validation is sufficient or green hosted CI is required for this workflow change.

options.title: Require green hosted CI
options.body: Resolve the lint failure and require all four matrix jobs to complete on the current head before merge.

options.title: Accept local validation
options.body: Merge based on the reported container and local builds while explicitly accepting that hosted CI did not exercise the new matrix.

recommendation.title: Require green hosted CI
recommendation.body: Resolve the lint failure and require all four matrix jobs to complete on the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the workflow change and is the only evidence-backed decision owner available for this repository-wide CI policy choice.
